approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce a detected workflow conflict source that has only a file link despite exact immutable parser text.
Attach a citation only when a non-vision statement ties the exact workflow identity to the matching longest bounded status phrase, or its fragment or locator is scoped to that identity alone.
Do not borrow a status phrase that belongs to another RFI or Submittal in the same fragment.
Manual corrections and detected summaries without an exact source phrase must remain visibly uncited.
Bound the local evidence read and do not call a model, reserve budget or infer chronology and authority.
title: Attach exact citations to detected workflow status conflicts
objective: Upgrade detected workflow conflict provenance from a file link to an exact immutable source quote and locator without fabricating support for manual or metadata-only states.
